description: For every \(M\models Q\), there is an arithmetic-language embedding \(j:\mathbb N_A\to M\) satisfying \(j(n)=n_M\) for every \(n\in\mathbb N\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.standard_embedding.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q] :
  ∃ e, ∀ (n : ℕ), e n = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M n
